post.title: Planet Fitness has about 7,300 members per gym. Here's why
post.ig:
Planet Fitness has about 7,300 members per gym.

21.5 million members across 2,930 clubs as of June 2026.
System-wide sales: $5.3 billion in 2025, mostly dues and annual fees.
A 2006 study: members on $70+ monthly plans went 4.3 times a month, over $17 a visit vs a $10 pass.
Example: $15 a month + $49 fee = $229 a year. 10 visits = $22.90 each.

Sources: Planet Fitness FY2025 and Q2 2026 results, DellaVigna & Malmendier (American Economic Review, 2006).
News and education, not financial advice.
Follow @financeprostv for money explained simply.
